headline: New test: selected series spanning two chunk ranges yields two hinted blocks
summary: Adds a test that appends one series across two 1000ms chunk ranges, runs CompactSelectedSeries, and checks the head is emptied and two blocks are written, each carrying the selected-series hint. It is test-only and adds coverage, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
reason: New test-only code that cannot affect production behavior and only adds coverage for per-chunk-range block output.
